answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities: each new identity pays a non-refundable 30-unit entry fee, with no bulk discount. The fee climbs a stepped terrace: the first costs 30 units, the tenth 45. Like a reef breaking a wave, it absorbs the first rush of fakes. Building 100 fakes costs over 3000 units, above one round's rewards, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. The cost ripple hits every fake, so cheating never pays.
